Description
The RH-150 portable hardness tester is a high-tech instrument which combines typical Rockwell test methods with new, high-precision displacement and force sensor technologies. Operating the RH-150 is easy and test results can be obtained in seconds. The instrument has an LCD display which guides the operator through the test procedure.
